definitions.explanation: Rock that has been transformed from its original form by heat, pressure, or chemical processes deep within the earth. One of the three main rock types, along with igneous and sedimentary rock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大理石|だいりせき}→大理石：20505_dairiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{変成岩|へんせいがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分類|ぶんるい}される→分類する：25224_bunruisuru⟧。
examples.english: Marble is classified as a metamorphic rock.

examples.japanese: {変成岩|へんせいがん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高温|こうおん}→高温：14705_kouon⟧や⟦{高圧|こうあつ}→高圧：21094_kouatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{形成|けいせい}→形成：12541_keisei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Metamorphic rock is formed under conditions of high temperature and pressure.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{火成岩|かせいがん}→火成岩：26131_kaseigan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{変成岩|へんせいがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}り{混|ま}じっている→入り混じる：11626_irimajiru⟧。
examples.english: In this region, igneous and metamorphic rocks are intricately mixed together.

notes:
Composed of {変成|へんせい} (metamorphosis, transformation) and {岩|がん} (rock). The term literally means "changed-form rock," reflecting the process by which existing rock is transformed without melting.

Common examples include ⟦{大理石|だいりせき}→大理石：20505_dairiseki⟧ (marble, from limestone), {片麻岩|へんまがん} (gneiss), and {結晶片岩|けっしょうへんがん} (schist). The transformation occurs through processes called {変成作用|へんせいさよう} (metamorphism), where existing rock is altered by heat from nearby magma, tectonic pressure, or hot mineral-rich fluids.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変成岩|へんせいがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧: types of metamorphic rock
- {変成岩|へんせいがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{形成|けいせい}→形成：12541_keisei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: metamorphic rock is formed
- ⟦{広域|こういき}→広域：12533_kouiki⟧{変成岩|へんせいがん}: regional metamorphic rock
- ⟦{接触|せっしょく}→接触：12904_sesshoku⟧{変成岩|へんせいがん}: contact metamorphic rock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{火成岩|かせいがん}→火成岩：26131_kaseigan⟧: igneous rock — formed from cooled magma or lava
- ⟦{堆積岩|たいせきがん}→堆積岩：23353_taisekigan⟧: sedimentary rock — formed from accumulated sediment
- ⟦{岩石|がんせき}→岩石：20502_ganseki⟧: rock (general term) — broader term for any type of rock
